attributes.board_name: Montana Board of Psychologists (Department of Labor & Industry)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Activities from qualified providers that contribute to professional knowledge and competence; the Board does not preapprove programs or sponsors. Maximum 30 h from advanced credentials, study groups, college classes, papers, research or case presentations; max 15 h personal growth (own psychotherapy, group therapy, supervision); max 10 h practice management.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE if licensed less than one full calendar year on the first reporting date; 20 h (1 ethics, 1 suicide prevention) if licensed less than two full calendar years. No CE while obtaining postdoctoral supervised experience.
rules.audit_note: Keep CE records for three years after a reporting period and provide them on request.
rules.notes: Licenses renew yearly (Nov 1 - Dec 31); CE is reported every 2 years: the two-year reporting period ends on the renewal date in odd-numbered years. Board page: «40 hours reported every 2 years». ARM 24.189.2110 was adopted as New Rule V of MAR 24-189-44 (adoption notice: adopted as proposed); quote from the Board's published proposal draft.
rules.rule_quote: (3) Each reporting period, psychologists must obtain 40 CE hours, of which two are in ethics and one in suicide prevention. The two-year reporting period ends on the renewal date set by ARM 24.101.413 in odd-numbered years.
